confirmed_failure.vendor_meaning: Auto Bed Leveling failed; the task has been stopped.

startup_comparison.reference_physical_outcome: Owner reported upright extrusion printed well; terminal print status also recorded FINISH before the first Bed 2 dispatch.

other_evidence.earlier_attempt_ended: Owner requested cancellation after a spool issue; stop acknowledged SUCCESS.

interpretation.confirmed: Firmware stopped the retry because automatic bed leveling failed. The manufacturer template and file integrity checks did not reveal a malformed startup sequence.
interpretation.hypothesis: The wider probing footprint may expose a physical bed/nozzle/probing issue outside the small central region used by the successful rail.
interpretation.avoid: Do not disable bed leveling to work around this failure.

logging_fix.change: Include fail_reason, mc_print_error_code and stg_cur in status summaries without treating historical fail_reason as an active fault.
logging_fix.dashboard_note: FP-RISC std/printertelemetry.fpr currently drops fail_reason. No dashboard code or deployment was changed in this investigation.
